verdict.rationale: skills.sh supports all three distribution paths in the story. Project-scope installs are the default and are documented as "Committed with your project, shared with team." Skills can be installed from shared GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos or private repos using existing auth. The skills.sh leaderboard and CLI search act as the marketplace, and a skills-lock.json restore lets teammates reproduce the same set. Community complaints about updating and versioning are general skepticism, not a concrete counter-example, so they don't create a dispute. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation of a team-wide lockfile restore workflow (the `experimental_install` command is labeled experimental) and any org-level policy or enforcement of a standard set.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project

citations.quote: Committed with your project, shared with team
